title: AGCO CORP /DE 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: AGCO Corporation filed an 8-K reporting results from its April 23, 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, including election of nine directors, a say-on-pay advisory resolution, ratification of KPMG as auditor for 2026, and a failed stockholder proposal on ability to call special stockholder meetings.
key_points: All nine director nominees (Arnold, Barbour, Clark, Collins, De Lange, Golodryga, Hansotia, Pörksen, Sagehorn) were elected for terms expiring at the 2027 Annual Meeting
Say-on-pay advisory resolution passed with 62.6 million votes for, 4.8 million against, and 29,518 abstentions
KPMG LLP ratified as independent auditor for 2026 with 64.4 million votes for against 4.9 million against
Stockholder proposal on ability to call special stockholder meetings failed with 32.8 million for versus 34.6 million against
Eric Hansotia and Niels Pörksen had the highest dissent votes among directors at approximately 1.55 million and 3.23 million respectively
